purpose: Sticky-TOC long-form article body, shared by blog-post and case-study

constraints.note: shared verbatim contract for template.blog-post and template.case-study -- structure (heading levels + paragraph word budgets) is real, measured per-post prose is the project's own already-generic placeholder copy per src/data/blogs.json:2 / case-studies.json:2

responsive.phone: Single column: ToC is not laid out as a sidebar; body stacks full-width.
responsive.tablet: Two-column layout begins (tablet:flex-row, tablet:gap-20): ToC becomes a fixed-width sidebar (tablet:w-px tablet:flex-1) beside the body.
responsive.desktop: Same two-column structure as tablet, with wider outer padding (desktop:px-40) and a larger heading scale (desktop:text-h3 vs tablet:text-h3-t).
